name: Cathedral Of Ixth
text1:
Attach this card to the elected planet. The owner of this planet gains 1 VP if their monument is on this planet.
When a player places their monument on this planet, they gain 1 VP. When a player's monument on this planet is removed, they lose 1 VP.
mapText: When a player places their monument on this planet, they gain 1 VP. When a player's monument on this planet is removed, they lose 1 VP.

name: Minister Of Culture
text1:
As long as the owner of this card controls their monument their commodity value is increased by 2.
The elected player gains this card and replenishes their commodities.
mapText: As long as the owner of this card controls their monument their commodity value is increased by 2.
